title: Settings
subtitle: Your preferences and the business rules behind assignment, the pipeline, messages and matching.

notFoundBody: Pick a section from the list.

profile.body: Your details, availability, theme and language.

assignment.title: Assignment rules
assignment.body: Auto-assignment on or off, workload cap and rules by location, type, language and source.

pipeline.title: Pipeline stages
pipeline.body: Stage names, which stages are used, target days, win probability and lost reasons.

templates.title: Message templates
templates.body: WhatsApp, SMS and email texts for intros, follow-ups, visits and offers.

matching.title: Matching weights
matching.body: How budget, location, size, amenities and preferences count in a match.

sla.title: Response times and scoring
sla.body: First-call time, escalation, stale and hot-lead rules, and the hot / warm thresholds.

users.title: Users
users.body: Who is on the team. Add, edit, activate and deactivate people on the Team page.

demo.title: Demo data
demo.body: Start again with a fresh set of sample leads, properties and visits.

summary.sla: First call in {{mins}} min · hot at {{hot}}

save.invalid: Fix the highlighted values to save

errors.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}
errors.escalateAfter: Escalation must come after the first-call time

profile.youHint: Shown to your team and on messages you send. Your email and role are set by an admin.
profile.name: Full name
profile.availabilityHint: Auto-assignment skips you while you are on leave; your manager is told about your open leads.
profile.languageHint: Menus and labels. Names and notes stay as typed.

theme.dark: Easy on the eyes in the evening.

assignment.autoBody: When on, every new lead (typed, imported or created by the assistant) goes to the executive with the lowest workload. Ties go round-robin; people on leave are skipped.
assignment.autoOnHint: On: new leads are assigned the moment they arrive.
assignment.autoOffHint: Off: new leads wait in the manager's unassigned queue.
assignment.managerNote: This switch applies to the whole company in this demo.
assignment.capHint: People at the cap are skipped unless everyone is at it.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: A rule sends matching leads to chosen people first. If none of them can take it, the normal workload rule applies.
rules.editorBody: Pick what the rule matches and who gets those leads.
rules.deleteBody: Matching leads will be assigned by workload only. You can undo for a few seconds.
rules.readOnly: Company-wide rule: only an admin can change it
rules.order: Rules are checked in this order: location, property type, language, source. The first one that matches narrows the pool.
rules.emptyBody: Without rules, leads go to whoever has the lowest workload.

ai.title: Describe the rule
ai.placeholder: e.g. Send Chennai and Hyderabad leads to Sneha
ai.nothing: Couldn't read a rule. Pick the values by hand.
ai.alsoFound: One condition per rule: I also saw {{kinds}}. Add a second rule for it.

simulator.title: Who would get a new lead?
simulator.body: Try the engine on a sample lead. Nothing is saved or assigned.
simulator.queue: It would wait in the unassigned queue
simulator.note: Uses today's workloads, the rules above and the round-robin turn.

pipeline.stagesBody: Rename a stage by typing a label. Target days decide when a deal looks stalled; probability feeds the forecast.
pipeline.lockedTip: New, Booked, Converted and Lost are always used.
pipeline.stripAria: Win chance rises through the stages
pipeline.lostBody: The reasons people choose when a lead is lost, in this order.
pipeline.needOneReason: Keep at least one reason on

templates.title: Templates
templates.body: Placeholders like {{p1}} and {{p2}} are filled for each lead when a message is drafted.
templates.editorBody: Write it yourself or let the assistant draft it, then edit freely.
templates.deleteBody: It will no longer be offered when drafting messages. You can undo for a few seconds.
templates.emptyBody: Add one so the follow-up assistant can draft messages.

matching.weightsBody: Match score = Σ weight × part score. The five weights must add up to 1.00.
matching.sumBad: The weights must add up to 1.00
matching.limitsBody: What counts as a match worth showing.
matching.minScoreHint: Matches below this are hidden from suggestions.
matching.capHint: Stops one big project filling the whole list.

sla.title: Response times
sla.body: Speed wins leads. These drive the first-call task, the breach alerts and the stale and hot-lead lists.
sla.firstResponseMinsHint: The first-call task is due then; a breach alerts the owner.
sla.escalateAfterMinsHint: If the lead is still not called.
sla.hotNoContactDays: Contact hot leads at least every
sla.hotNoContactDaysHint: Hot leads past this show first on Today.

scoring.title: Hot, warm and cold
scoring.body: A lead's score (0–100) sets its temperature. Overrides by hand still win.
scoring.bandAria: Cold below {{warm}}, warm from {{warm}}, hot from {{hot}}

demo.title: Reset demo data
demo.body: Replaces everything with a fresh sample dated around today. Your profile, theme and language stay.
demo.warning: Every lead, property, visit, task, note and setting you changed is replaced. This can't be undone.
demo.confirmBody: All changes made in this browser are replaced by fresh sample data. This can't be undone.
demo.doneHint: Fresh sample data for today is loaded.
